nodes.label: Composition actions (parameterized step bundles)
nodes.author: Perfscale Team
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the first marketplace execution mechanism: an action expands to existing built-in steps, giving zero new execution surface, zero sandbox problem, and no arbitrary code — value ships in weeks before any WASM investment. Cannot express new behavior (no gRPC via composition), so WASM remains the code-action target once a concrete need justifies the sandbox work.

nodes.label: WASM component actions with capability model
nodes.author: Perfscale Team
nodes.rationale: The credible answer for third-party code actions: wasmtime sandbox, narrow host API, declared capabilities (net, read-file) enforced by the engine. Deferred because sandboxing untrusted code in a load generator is a permanent security commitment (botnet-weaponization risk, metrics-integrity risk, per-iteration cost compounding, and WASM's inability to hold the engine's keep-alive connection pool).

nodes.label: MinIO-backed static registry with lockfile pinning
nodes.author: Perfscale Team
nodes.rationale: Chosen over building a real package registry: MinIO already serves the agent binary with anonymous download and sha256 verification, so a static JSON index plus artifacts keyed by marketplace/<publisher>/<name>/<version> yields a cheap MVP. Explicit perfscale install + perfscale.lock (version + digest) is chosen over implicit run-time fetch, which would be a remote-code-execution footgun; run time stays offline against the cache.
